description: Free URL submission for your own sites: notify Bing and other engines through IndexNow and Bing Webmaster Tools in one call, and get the next step for Google. Google has no public API to request indexing of normal pages, so this only notifies engines and cannot force Google; resubmit the sitemap (free) or use force indexing (quote_force_indexing, paid) when Google needs to crawl now. Free; never uses the Google Indexing API.
